title: Gorsi Ogummaa Keessatti Bocame
intro: Mee fakkii dinqiidhaan ykn mootummaadhaan osoo hin taane, jechoota har’as garaa qajeelchaniin beekamu cinaa dhaabbattee yaadi. Gabrichi Rabbii kun kennaa qaalii argatee gorsa dargaggeessa barataa jaallatamaa tokkoof kennamu hunda keessatti galata dhangalaase.
clues: Rabbiin ogummaan eebbifame, akkan galateeffadhus ajajame.
Ilma koo wajjin gorsa gara laafaatiin, jaalalaa fi yaaddoodhaan akeekkachiisuun dubbadhe.
Rabbiin waliin shariika gochuun badii guddaa akka ta’e ilma kootti hime.
Ilmi koo kadhannaa akka hundeessu, sirrii akka ajaju, badii akka dhoorku, obsaan akka obsu gorse.
Ilmi koo of tuuluun qoonqa akka hin garagalchinee fi of tuulummaadhaan lafa irra akka hin deemne akeekkachiiseera.
Ilmi koo saffisa isaa giddu galeessa akka taʼuu fi sagalee isaa akka gadi buusu nan barsiiseera, sababiin isaas sagaleewwan gara jabeeyyii taʼan sagalee harreewwanii waan taʼaniif.

trial.label: Gorsa Koo Guddaa
options: Mucaa koo Rabbiin waliin shariika akka hin goone gorsuu
Bishaan badiisaa guddaa sanarraa lubbuun hafuuf doonii ijaaruu
Abjuu bulchaa osoo mana hidhaa jiruu hiikuu
Fara’oon mallattoo dinqisiisaa ta’een fuuldura dhaabbachuu
trial.answer: Mucaa koo Rabbiin waliin shariika akka hin goone gorsuu

outcome.label: Akkamitti Na yaadatama
options: Akkuma namni tokko kufriidhaaf lolaa keessatti liqimfame
Akka nama of tuuluuf lafaan liqimfame
Akka fakkeenya galateeffannaa fi gorsa warra ogummaa qabuutti
Akka nama dhohinsa cimaa samii irraa badeetti
Akka namni tokko Sanbata cabsuuf jijjiirame
outcome.answer: Akka fakkeenya galateeffannaa fi gorsa warra ogummaa qabuutti

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
